summary: No new Alphabet business news: the Nov 23-24 filings (424B2, listing certificate, 8-K) close out the C$6 billion Canadian-dollar note sale already logged on Nov 20. Anthropic, where Google holds a stake, closed below its $83 IPO price on Nov 24; the nightly stake mark already carries that price in the sum-of-the-parts.

items.headline: Alphabet 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) completing the C$6 billion Canadian-dollar notes offering; 424B2 and listing certificate on Nov 23
items.why: Filings confirmed on the EDGAR submissions list (accession 0001193125-26-475973); the note sale was already logged Nov 20. The 8-K text itself could not be opened (sec.gov archive refused the request), so its exhibit detail is taken from the relay.

items.headline: Anthropic closes below its $83 IPO price in its fourth trading session
items.why: Lowers the market value of Google's Anthropic stake in the sum-of-the-parts leg; this is a price, not a new fact about Alphabet's cash flows, and runs/2026-11-24/stake_marks.json already marks it ($27.06B, was $32.59B; engine $293.77). No driver row covers it.
